newsitem.title: FRANCE: French ONIC raises maize export forecast.
newsitem.headline: French ONIC raises maize export forecast.

text.p: France's maize exports to other European Union states were forecast to rise by 435,000 tonnes to 6.435 million tonnes in 1996/97, the grain office ONIC confirmed on Wednesday.
In a new supply/demand report released ahead of ONIC's monthly news conference, the office also cut the maize carryover to 2.519 million tonnes from 2.825 million forecast last month.
France exported 6.087 million tonnes of maize to other EU states in 1995/96 and ended that campaign with a maize carryover of 1.647 million tonnes.
ONIC slightly raised its estimate for the 1996 maize crop to 14.280 million tonnes from 14.212 million last month and 12.394 million in 1995.

ONIC made few changes to its balance sheet for barley. It kept its forecast for French barley exports to non-EU states at 1.5 million tonnes. This compares with 221,000 tonnes exported to non-EU states in 1995/96.
Barley exports to other EU states were raised by 20,000 tonnes to 2.280 million tonnes from 2.260 million tonnes and the carryover reduced to 1.045 million tonnes from 1.115 milion tonnes.
It also held its estimate for the 1996 barley crop at 9.5 million tonnes. This compares with 7.739 million tonnes harvested in 1995.
